ClientResponses.Response: Hi Kenny, we're really sorry that you've had these experiences with your Timberline.  We're glad to see that you've been getting help through our Customer Support, if there is anything else we can do, please reach out to us at 1-800-TRAEGER.

Results.ReviewText:
I've read the reviews of other grills and especially the new Timberline 850. It sounds like there are systemic issues with all Timberline products at tis point. The one star issues for this grill are identical to mine. I really hadn't used the grill much although I had registered until just recently. I while back, it had caught fire and the response was that I had not cleaned it out. Not really. Several months ago I went to use it and it would not turn on. I verified there was power. Solution, replace the control board under warranty. You wouldn't believe how hard it is to actually accomplish this or how many zip ties were employed. Never the less, i got it done and back up and running. Then this past week, while smoking ribs 3,2,1 method near the end of step 2, the temp kept dropping, fan and pellet worm still turning. I set the ribs on my gas grill to keep them steaming and opened the grill. The burn pot was over flowing with pellets and there were about three or four more full pots worth in the bottom. I can't imagine what would happen if it suddenly started working again, but stay turned.
Traeger wanted a video since they were sure on or the other fan or worm were not working. during the call I got disconnected, no call back. Two shutdowns and restarts later I got it working. Finishined. 

Then durning a heat up to burn off the gunk, same thing happened again and when I went to check after about 10-15 minutes to see if I was done, temp is 550 and the grill is on fire. Discovered they don't use high temp paint since there are now several spots where it's blistered.

So now they are replacing the temp probe and heating element under warranty. I'll wait and see what's next.
Results.Title: Renegrade Pro Plagued with Problems

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText: Not only is the grill EXACTLY what my husband wanted for Father’s Day, we had the added bonus of discovering the box doubles as a little play house for the kiddo and the instructions show how to assemble with a beer gauge. It may seem silly to be hung up on these details, but it speaks to a level of thought in the design process...that the company cares THAT much about their product and the name/reputation behind the product.
Results.Title: Thought of Every Detail

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black

Photos.Caption: After I emptied the smoldering mess

Results.ReviewText: I used my grill for Father’s Day worked great. Did the normal shutdown feature. The next day I come home for lunch and I smell smoke the hole pellet storage area is smoldering and smoking. I open it up and there embers in there and the inside had been burning for who knows how long. I put out the embers and emptied the storage box. I called Traeger thinking that they could help and they said there is nothing they can do and have never seen this before.
Results.Title: Catches on fire day after use

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Bronze - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I have owned my smoker for 2 years and really enjoy using it. Traeger is very easy to use and enjoy the results.
Results.Title: Awesome smoker easy to use

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Bronze - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: Was given this grill for a birthday present. Was very excited to start cooking and did a brisket. Turn out very moist.  I've been using it for a couple of months but the one thing I wished it had was super smoke. I don't feel like I'm getting the smoke I wished for. So I wouldn't recomend this grill if you like to add smoke.
Results.Title: Easy to cook on

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: Bought the pro 780 after hours and hours of research was seriously considering camp chef or rec tec but they r sold out for the rest of the summer. Went with the nfm 24 month 0% financing to justify the price tag. Smoked ribs and was completely satisfied with everything treager brags about. Looking forward to a brisket.
Results.Title: Temp control was perfect

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: Great product but it could use a built in shelf and storage compartment. The optional shelf you can buy makes it difficult to open the grill when you have something on the shelf.
Results.Title: 1st month with the grill

ClientResponses.Response: Hey Devon, we're sorry that you've had these problems with your grill, we would like to help.  Please give us a call at 1-800-TRAEGER, one of our team members will get you squared away.

Results.ReviewText: It is sufficient as a grill. I'm disappointed in spending a thousand dollars on something that says in the products description that you can use as a smoker and come to find Theout, it can't. In the section for why to buy traegar it even says that you can control the amount of smoke, that was also false. I wanted a smoker and did not receive a smoker. The other major draw to the product was the wifire, I have yet to get that to connect with my grill being within fifteen feet of my wifi. I am not pleased with this product, I could have spent a fifth of what I did on a product that takes up a quarter of the space.
Results.Title: Mislead and disappointed

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: My first grill was a Texas Elite 34 which I love, the only fallback was that I would have to find recipes that were close to the same temparatures as the meat. This became a little cumbersome. I decided to by a Pro 780 black as the bronze was out of stock to accompany the Texas Elite so I can cook my meats at any temparature on the Pro 780 and time the rest of the meal including dessert on the Texas Elite. Who knows, there may be a third Traeger parked on my patio in the near future!!!
Results.Title: Traeger grills are the BEST!!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText: Love my Pro 575! Easy to install, had very few issues with WiFi setup, and have loved everything I’ve smoked or grilled!
Results.Title: Does NOT disappoint! Love it!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText: I had my Traeger for 15+ years. The Pro 575 has amazing upgrades. The WiFi is fantastic. And, the Traeger App with all the information is great. Everything is at your fingertips. The quality of the Traeger is superb. Easy to assembly & cooking is excellent. A win-win purchase for years to come!!
Results.Title: Traeger Grill, Pro 575

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText: I love this grill for most things! The one thing I wish Traeger would do in later models is have a way to get a really good sear, bumping up the top heat range to 700 or having the option to add on a sear box would make this for sure 5 star!
Results.Title: Great grill could be better for searing

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black

ClientResponses.Response: Hey Brian, we're sorry that you're having these problems with your grill and our app, we would like to help. Please give us a call at 1-800-TRAEGER, one of our team members will get you squared away.

Results.ReviewText: Bought the 575 here probably 3 weeks ago. I was excited to say the least. I never owned a pellet grill but I have an electric smoker also. I'm not a fan of the lack of smoke. Traeger says it's fine, "it's there, you just can barely see it" Well I feel if I pay over 800 dollars I want it to smoke like a snoop dog concert if I want it to. Little disappointed. The app doesn't work consistently. Force closing the app constantly to make it work. You set temp and I have to go check outside to see if it switched the temp because honestly I don't trust it. I thought this was a high standard grill here and I don't think the hype is as good as I thought it to be. Don't believe me , read the others.
Results.Title: For what you pay for.

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Bronze - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I’m rating this Traeger a 10! I’ve impressed my friends & family members with some great meals. Thank you, Traeger...you’re a class act!
Results.Title: Love it, love it, love it!
